namespace = zz_clean

# 干净样本：所有写法都合规，lint 必须 0 error（防误报基准）。
# 本文件不含任何游戏素材。

country_event = {
	id = zz_clean.1
	title = "zz_clean.1.t"
	desc = "zz_clean.1.d"
	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		treasury = 100
		num_of_cities = 3
	}

	immediate = {
		add_prestige = 5
		set_country_flag = zz_clean_done
	}

	option = {
		name = "zz_clean.1.a"
		add_years_of_income = 0.5
	}
}
